People: Roger de Rabutin Bussy (author, Wikidata Q733246), died 1693; Charles-Louis Livet (other, Wikidata Q15078852), died 1897; Paul Boiteau d'Ambly (editor, Wikidata Q18011964), died 1886. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Bussy, Roger de Rabutin, comte de, 1618-1693; Livet, Charles-Louis, 1828-1897 [Contributor]; Boiteau d'Ambly, Paul, 1830-1886 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Histoire amoureuse des Gaules, [Paris] Garnier-Flammarion, 1967, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/histoireamoureu02livegoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 39%, 86%, 79% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Paul Boiteau d'Ambly, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
